snippet.title: Fate/Grand Order: Cosmos in the Lostbelt - Lostbelt No. 7 (Part 1) - Daybit Ver.
snippet.description:
Discover what lies next in Part 2 Chapter 7 "Lostbelt No.7: Golden Sea of Trees, Nahui Mictlān - Those Who Rule the Planet" (Part 1), available now!

The Foreign God has attacked the Wandering Sea. Chaldea escapes in the Storm Border, though at great cost. Now they begin their attempt to enter the seventh Lostbelt and finally put a stop to the Foreign God's terrible machinations.

This seventh Lostbelt is situated in the Amazon rainforest of South America. A lush, fertile land brimming with trees, this place nurtured many forms of life. This place is said to have been the wellspring of all life on Earth. But, with the Tree of Emptiness having taken root, this place has become a wasteland of death, of cracked soil and parched earth, overhung with rumbling thunderheads.

Why is this once-lush land now dead? What course did this Lostbelt's history take?

In this harsh South American Lostbelt, devoid of all life, humanity readies itself to confront the only remaining threat.

For more information, please visit the official website: https://fate-go.us/nahui_mictlan/ 

For more information check out Fate/Grand Order online!
